why: A (universes at 0) has five theorems: one_le_ncard_fiber, eventually_ncard_fiber_eq, isLocallyConstant_ncard_fiber, isLocallyConstant_fiberCardOrbit and proposition_8_6_4. A_to_B: constancy on the components of |X| is proposition_8_6_4, and the bound ≥ 1 is one_le_ncard_fiber. B's sc-smooth functor X → ℕ is not the project's fiberCardFunctor, whose smoothness field is the banned isLocallyConstant_ncard_fiber. It is the same functor rebuilt from A's isLocallyConstant_ncard_fiber (continuity into discrete ℕ, then the non-item isScSmoothMap_discrete_of_continuous), with φ ↦ #F⁻¹(s φ) and the non-item Lemma 8.6.3 for t. B_to_A: B's functor E is sc-smooth, so E.obj = (x ↦ #F⁻¹(x)) is continuous into discrete ℕ, hence locally constant. That gives isLocallyConstant_ncard_fiber, eventually_ncard_fiber_eq and, through the quotient topology, isLocallyConstant_fiberCardOrbit. proposition_8_6_4 and one_le_ncard_fiber are B's first and third conjuncts. Same content; both sides read ℕ = {1, 2, …} as Lean's ℕ plus the bound ≥ 1.
overlap: B_to_A: 445 shared project theorems. Most are M-polyfold infrastructure (fibred products, charts, discretePolyfold). The Chapter 8 counting lemmas (ncard_fiber_eq_of_isomorphic, lemma_8_6_3, lemma_8_6_1, ncard_fiber_eq_sum, fiberIndex_eq, srcFiberEquiv, …) are reached through the body of the vocabulary definition fiberCardOrbit in A's statement (well-definedness on |X|), not used by the proof itself. No item theorem.
